title: FLUX.2 [klein] Move: Interactive Object Relocation LoRA
summary: A specialized LoRA for the FLUX.2 [klein] 9B model that enables precise interactive object movement within generated scenes. It preserves character identity and texture consistency during spatial editing using bounding-box or drag-and-drop workflows.
research_notes: Optimal inference strength is 0.65–0.75; identity preservation is centered in double blocks 6-7 of the Klein architecture.

evolution.summary: The project has progressed from v3 to v11, adding specialized models for bounding-box drag-and-drop editing. These updates improve identity locking by targeting specific architectural blocks and integration into interactive Hugging Face Spaces.
